key_reasoning.reason: The final diff from 6cda5408f to 6a1b07d1b changes ThoughtMessage tool identification and the shared TextBlock renderer, plus three test suites. Base S is bumped to M for the shared rendering utility: Thought Input and WorkflowStateOutput also consume TextBlock, so default-off compatibility matters. Their callers, hydration, exports, stores, and configuration remain unchanged; preserving multiple workflows is not a separate workflow-change bump.

The supplied final scope and implementation agree on opt-in plain-text tool Results, a 60-rendered-line threshold, first/last 20 lines, exact hidden counts, full-width disclosure controls, streaming choice retention, and exclusions for Input, Markdown, WorkflowState JSON, documents, media, and assistant copy. Human approval resolves the final UX decisions; no open acceptance decision is evident.

Closest existing pattern: ThoughtDocument uses local React disclosure state, a native full-width button, and cn styling; TextBlock retains its existing newline splitting/filtering and React text rendering. Base S is bumped to M because the prior ThoughtDocument and ThoughtMessage suites do not cover the new threshold boundary, metadata variants, or focus transfer between relocated controls; the final diff adds parameterized boundary/variant suites and keyboard-focus assertions. Streaming then bumps M to L: incoming text must update the tail/count without resetting expansion. No new HTML sink, sanitization surface, auth path, or external integration is introduced. Calibration remains S overall, comparable to epmcdme-10102-add-validation-to-form-field.json (11), but with greater streaming/defensive risk and file count; unlike the adjacent epmcdme-10203-add-rest-endpoint-with-business-logic.json (15), this change has explicit final criteria and only one architectural layer.

The actual-mode file-count mapping assigns M to five files. Git name-status confirms four modified files and one new TextBlock.test.tsx across Thought and markdown component directories, all under src/components. The aggregate diff exactly matches the supplied final scope: 617 insertions and 14 deletions; the earlier implementation freeze is not used.
No manifest, lockfile, version, environment, or configuration change appears in the final diff. React hooks, the existing chevron asset, cn, and installed testing libraries are reused.

Only the UI layer changes. Local disclosure state does not add a Service layer; tests invoking existing hydration and clipboard paths do not change API or External layers. No persistence, migration, infrastructure, or cross-system coordination is introduced.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from S to M: touches the shared TextBlock rendering utility used by tool Results, Inputs, and workflow state output.
Technical Risk bumped from S to M: explicit threshold, metadata-variant, and relocated-control focus cases lack an adequate pre-existing defensive test template.
Technical Risk bumped from M to L: streaming requirements require live tail/count updates while retaining the user's disclosure choice.
